title: Compatible public-account lifecycle foundation
summary: Added rollback-compatible account, service-selection, contact-preference, consent-evidence, and identity-linking storage ahead of the public lifecycle cutover.
changes: Added normalized username and onboarding state plus additive UK contact fields while retaining the legacy phone field.
Added per-user service selections, current contact preferences, append-only consent evidence, and expiring OIDC link intents.
Backfilled existing public accounts with all three services and false contact defaults without inventing consent events.
version_rationale: A compatible patch establishing additive storage and backfills before user-facing account lifecycle behavior is enabled.
validation: Fresh and upgrade migration tests cover schema, email collision refusal, service backfills, false consent defaults, and preserved OIDC-only accounts.
known_limitations: Registration, onboarding, service gating, and explicit identity linking remain disabled until the following compatible releases.
rollback: The previous release ignores the additive columns and tables. Existing records and legacy phone data remain available; no destructive cleanup is performed.
provenance: Defined by the first compatible delivery phase for MyAPES Account issue #19.
